<!-- pr-reviewer: f535eb10909a5e071b2f27306fa047938fe8486c -->
**Needs changes before merge** (read, not built: this PR adds `.github/` workflow and scripts, so a maintainer must look at them first).

Reviewed only the commits beyond 04f96223 (`git diff 04f96223 f535eb10`); #1418 is already reviewed. Not built, actionlint/shellcheck not available here; read line by line.

**What looks good**
- Triggers are only `push: main` and `workflow_dispatch`; no `pull_request`, `pull_request_target` or `schedule`, so no fork event can reach the runner. A dispatch needs write access.
- No script injection: `github.event.*` text (commit messages, refs) is never interpolated into a `run:` body. `inputs.ref` and the sha reach the scripts only through `env:`.
- Permissions are minimal: top-level `contents: read`; gate job adds only `actions: read`/`pull-requests: read`; only the report job has `issues: write`; `persist-credentials: false`; no token in the gate step.
- A failed `gh` call in `post-merge-skip.sh` falls through to "run the gate" (fails toward testing, not toward hiding a red). A skip never closes or comments on the rolling issue, so a skipped run cannot turn a red main green.
- `cancel-in-progress` is acceptable: the newer run tests a head that contains the cancelled commit, and a cancelled run reports nothing, so a red is only dropped if a later head fixes it (then it was fixed). Report fires on success/failure only.
- The "FAIL" row regex matches xtask's summary format (`xtask/src/exec.rs:230`). The `#1451` quote in AGENTS.md ("Can we setup a build test post merge using local gh runner?") is real (issue body). PROCESS_VERSION 61 vs upstream 60 is fine (settled at merge, as stated).

**Local results**: not built (needs maintainer look at `.github/workflows/post-merge.yml`, `.github/scripts/*.sh` first). Merge with main: CONFLICTS (stacked on unmerged #1418); not trial-merged.

**Requested before merge**
1. Priority mapping contradicts AGENTS.md "Priorities" (the scale is `P1`..`P9`; `P0` was retired, now `P1`). `post-merge-report.sh:47-58` files `P1` for every red and `P0` on a name heuristic (also AGENTS.md "Fixes are tested in the background" text and `docs/decisions/1451-post-merge-gate.md`). Law: a red result is `P1` if it is wrong output or a gouge, else `P2` (a gate on main is red). Fix: default `P2`; `P1` only when a failing step is a posted-output suite (golden/gcode/post); drop the `P0` label, and the `--add-label P0 --remove-label P1` edit becomes `--add-label P1 --remove-label P2`. Update the AGENTS.md text and decision file to match. (The `P0` label still exists in the repo, so today the call would succeed and mint a retired priority; the issue text asked for it, but AGENTS.md governs.)
2. The heuristic `grep -qiE 'golden|gcode|g_code|post'` (`post-merge-report.sh:35`) is loose: `post` matches any step whose name or note contains it (e.g. the `camcraft-post` crate's whole suite, or words like "compost"/"postfix"), and a red outside those names can still post wrong output (sim, motion). Since it now only chooses P1 vs P2, keep it, but say in the script comment that it is a heuristic and anchor to suite names (`-p camcraft-post`, `golden`, `gcode`) rather than bare `post`.
3. Escalation on an existing issue should also work in the other direction only by human action; fine as is, but note an already-P1 issue is never lowered (OK).

**Questions / notes (not blocking)**
- Issue closing: the script finds the issue by exact title among open issues and closes it on green, with no author or `source:agent` check. A human-filed issue with that exact title would be closed by a green run; adding `--label source:agent` to the search closes that gap.
- Skip window: merges that land during a cut are not post-merge tested (documented trade-off). An issue left red from before a cut stays open until the next non-skipped green run; consider noting that in the skip notice.
- A `workflow_dispatch` with a non-main ref shares the `post-merge-main` concurrency group and can cancel a running main gate (and vice versa); a separate group for non-main refs would avoid that.
- The `P0`/`P1` labels, `effort:low`, `area:build`, `source:agent` all exist; `source:agent` and an effort label are set as the law requires.
- Fork note: Needs the maintainer's decision on a `push` trigger (AGENTS.md says only with the user's say-so; the issue records it).

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
